proposed_facts.reason: Canonical lines 68–78 implement the stated current-X-to-uniform-scale transformation. Lines 106–109 register the child process before animation attachment, request, and evaluation.

The transformation reads current scale rather than an immutable initial value. Animation is attached to the same child, so uninterrupted geometric decay is not established. The null-root branch sets child to NULL and proceeds to scale access without a local early return.

Primary construction and rendering registration are explicit. The null-terminated loop selects indices 1–3 using the unsigned comparison, rather than guaranteeing three additional descriptors. The proposal correctly describes the Corneria helper as returning a GObj without asserting distinct allocation.

Primary animation evaluation precedes process registration at priority 0x17; child registration at priority 2 precedes attachment and initial evaluation. The document and proposal consistently preserve this distinction.
